latestVersion.changelog:
editor-list 1.0.0

- Initial release of a cloud-based tool for managing and viewing editor access in video projects.
- Upload video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB), view and manage editor lists and their access levels, and export projects as 1080p MP4 files.
- Automatic session and authentication handling using API tokens; requires no local installation.
- Supports team workflows—assign/edit/remove collaborators and quickly review project editor status.
- Key features include streamlined exports, clear error messaging, and session state management for fast project iteration.
